ValidationRule.description: HRP-4878 If Web Sched Offset from CO/Global Settings value is unchecked, Web Schedule Start Date,Start Time,End Date,End Time fields must be populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((Web_Sched_Offset_from_CO_Global_Settings__c == False) && Is_Template__c == True && ( ISBLANK(Web_Scheduling_Start_Date_Offset__c) || ISPICKVAL(Web_Scheduling_Start_Time__c,"") || ISBLANK(Web_Scheduling_End_Time_Offset__c) || ISBLANK(Web_Scheduling_End_Date_Offset__c) )) || ((Web_Sched_Offset_from_CO_Global_Settings__c == True) && Is_Template__c == True && ( NOT(ISBLANK(Web_Scheduling_Start_Date_Offset__c)) || NOT(ISPICKVAL(Web_Scheduling_Start_Time__c,"")) || NOT(ISBLANK(Web_Scheduling_End_Time_Offset__c)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Web_Scheduling_End_Date_Offset__c)) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please either check the checkbox ‘Web Scheduling Offset from CO/Global Setting’ or enter Web Scheduling Offset values on the Template.
